The contained program's name map used to be ONE flat tier (its own names + the containers' globals), so a local X and a container's global G.X were co-candidates (COBOL1639 ambiguous), for condition-names too. Every inherited global item now carries its nesting depth (DataBinder.InheritGlobalSubtree) and SymbolTable.NearestDeclaring narrows the QUALIFIED survivor set to the nearest declaring element — SymbolTable.IdentifyDataName, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates and ConditionBinder.ConditionOf ask it; two survivors in that one element stay ambiguous (negative). Siblings on the same rule, fixed: a nearer DATA-name now hides a farther global INDEX-name (SymbolTable.IndexCandidates) and a farther global CONSTANT-name (InheritStep.DropShadowed, depth-aware). Golden legs: I X=LOC (3a), I C=FALSE (3a, 88), I IX=7 (3a across name classes), I XG=MID (qualification first, then 3b1), J X=MID / J C=TRUE (3b1), T K=MDK (3b1, constant vs data). kb/Work PB4196: a REPORT SECTION entry is a data-name of the source element that declares its report, so it takes part in the same ranking: SymbolTable.NearestDeclaringData / NearestDeclaringConditions (the narrowings, asked by TryResolveUnqualified, DataNameCandidates and IdentifyConditionName) leaves no survivor when ReportScope.NearerEntryHides finds a report entry of a NEARER source element that the written qualifiers reach, so the callers' report-item refusal (COBOL5092, §13.8.6.2.3) names the entry instead of the container's lone GLOBAL data item or condition-name being used; SymbolTable.NearerDataNameHides (index-names, capacity registers) and DataBinder.DeclaredNearerThan (constants) ask it too. A qualifier that reaches only the container's item, and a nearer data item against a farther GLOBAL report entry, keep their old answers. kb/Work PB4219 (wave 20261819, the data-name / condition-name sibling): rule 1's set is 'all names', so a condition-name and a data-name of one spelling compete; NearestDeclaringData leaves no survivor when SymbolTable.NearerConditionNameHides finds a nearer condition-name the written qualifiers reach, and NearestDeclaringConditions none when NearerDataNameHides finds a nearer data-name.
